title: pine garland
text: pine garland. I did NOT receive what was photographed.  I got a very awful looking garland with a few broken, brittle pine cones and NO lights, NO red berries - just a super sad garland. I think I got the wrong garland - it did come in a plastic bag that looked like it came directly out of a dumpster.  It should have stayed there. VERY disappointing.
